documents_expected.why: general criteria, exclusions, grant stages, reporting
FAQs: references, who receives funds, started projects, reports

eligibility.quote: Applicants should be in the early stages of their conservation careers.
alt_quotes: However, we do not fund undergraduate students.

eligibility.quote: Projects must have a nature conservation focus.
Applicants must be working in an eligible country

eligibility.rule: Species worked on are threatened (not Least Concern)
eligibility.quote: For projects focusing on species, we consider work on any NOT listed as Least Concern at a global level in the IUCN Red List of Threatened Species.
alt_quotes: Any species you are working on must be considered threatened.

eligibility.rule: No pure research, expeditions, conferences or books
eligibility.quote: The following types of projects will NOT be eligible for support.
No, the Foundation will not fund projects that have already begun.
You can only make one funding application in any 12-month period.

eligibility.rule: Funds go to a host organisation, not a personal account
eligibility.quote: No, funds will only be paid to an organisation such as a nature conservation NGO or university.

documents.quote: Yes, you need to provide three references - applications cannot be processed until these have been received.

documents.item: Evidence of co-funding where others also fund
documents.quote: Where The Rufford Foundation is not the only funder, we require evidence of co-funding.

effort.step: Create an account and apply online in English, at any time
alt_quotes: The application and references must be submitted in English.
There are no deadlines - applications can be submitted at any time of year.

effort.quote: Once your application is submitted, your three referees will be contacted automatically to submit their references.

after_award.quote: You must provide project updates and a final report on project completion, copies of which will be posted on your webpage.
alt_quotes: Also, you must submit a final evaluation report using the Final Report template.

notes: Staged grants: 1st RSG up to £7,000, 2nd £8,000, Booster £12,000, Completion £18,000; rolling. Co-funding is only required at the Completion stage ('We will require evidence of support from other sources'), so the programme-wide flag stays empty. The Word form questions (not convertible in gather-2) repeat the criteria and add no new rules.
